items.title: Boston Scientific (BSX) Stock Sees Modest Fair Value Cut As Watchman Concerns Reset Expectations
items.summary: Analyst fair value for Boston Scientific has shifted from US$75.00 to US$72.25, pointing to a modest reset in price targets.
